name: damage_feedback_set_intensity_scalar
description: DamageFeedback::SetIntensityScalar stores the per-hit damage-feedback intensity scalar used by OptCatalog hit feedback dispatch.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2900 validates a single stack float argument, stdcall callee cleanup, and a store into the global damage-feedback intensity scalar.
The native smoke verifies that DamageFeedback::SetIntensityScalar updates the recovered scalar global.
